summary: Segmented time field with a popover of fixed-step times, unavailable times, and clearing.
whenToUse: Choosing a time from regular slots (every 15/30/60 minutes).
whenNotToUse: Date and time together: use DateTimePicker.
Arbitrary times down to the second without a list: use TimeInput.
Durations: use NumberInput with a unit.

props.name: value / defaultValue / onChange
props.description: Wall-clock time, with no date or time zone.

props.name: step
props.description: Step, in minutes, of the list.

props.name: minValue / maxValue
props.description: Limits: out-of-range times are disabled and validated.

props.name: isTimeUnavailable
props.description: Disables individual times in the list.

props.name: hourCycle
props.description: Forces the format (by default it follows the language).

inherits: Props of react-aria-components TimeField (granularity, name, isRequired, validate…).

keyboard.action: Moves the selection; Enter confirms and closes.
Closes the list; focus returns to the field.

accessibility: Button with the localized name “Choose time”; the popover is a dialog with a “Times” listbox.
On open, focus moves to the selected time, which is scrolled into view.
responsive: The list has a maximum height and scrolls; the popover stays within the viewport.
customization: className on the field, popoverProps.className on the popover.
commonMistakes: Using TimePicker for a precise instant with a time zone: use DateTimePicker with ZonedDateTime.
Relying on step as validation: the field accepts any typed time.
limits: The list shows hours and minutes; seconds can only be set from the segments.
